name: CANDY GIRL
source:
Main character is a normal office worker, brother or trainer - depending on the choice. But in every path your opponent is a doll with a soul. Can dolls really pursue the same way of life as people?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
根据选择不同，主人公可以是一名普通上班族、哥哥或训练师。但无论进入哪条路线，你所面对的都是一个拥有灵魂的人偶。人偶真的能够追求与人类相同的生活方式吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
